allowedActiveChanges.name: add-subsystem-lanes-and-ci
allowedActiveChanges.reason: Declarative-first change: proposal/design/specs/tasks authored ahead of implementation per Seam-First Ladder W6 council decision (openspec/council-decisions/2026-07-09-ui-audit-testability-architecture.md). Implementation starts only after the W5 (add-viewport-layout-sweep) implementation merges to main (ladder sequencing); the pack-tagging group additionally gates on the W4 (add-scenario-packs) implementation landing.

allowedActiveChanges.name: establish-entity-event-journal-contract
allowedActiveChanges.reason: Wave 1 of the user-requested entity-history program: define an adapter-neutral TypeScript journal envelope, one owning stream plus indexed entity links, atomic expected-revision command batches, command receipts, and a SQLite conformance adapter before any production authority cutover.

allowedActiveChanges.name: add-replay-schema-and-checkpoint-safety
allowedActiveChanges.reason: Wave 2 of the entity-history program: add explicit event schemas, deterministic upcasters, versioned projectors, cache-only checkpoints, full-replay equivalence, and per-session quarantine before production journal adoption.

allowedActiveChanges.name: adopt-combat-event-journal-authority
allowedActiveChanges.reason: Wave 3 of the entity-history program: bind existing combat events to the durable journal, enforce decide-commit-apply-publish ordering, preserve the browser log as a recovery mirror, and cut over new matches only after replay/state parity.

allowedActiveChanges.name: adopt-campaign-event-journal-authority
allowedActiveChanges.reason: Wave 4 of the entity-history program: replace process-local campaign history with atomic durable batches, preserve customized-unit and campaign entity lineage, make snapshots materialized projections, and close replay/live synchronization gaps.

allowedActiveChanges.name: add-cross-stream-effect-receipts
allowedActiveChanges.reason: Wave 5 of the entity-history program: add transactional outbox/inbox receipts, side-effect-free replay, causal cross-stream history, and exactly-once combat-to-campaign effect application over at-least-once delivery.

allowedActiveChanges.name: add-authoritative-history-branches
allowedActiveChanges.reason: Wave 6 of the entity-history program: add immutable branch lineage, verified replacement-branch activation, domain-command revalidation instead of generic merge, and authorized combat/campaign correction timelines after linear authority and effect receipts are proven.

allowedActiveChanges.name: harden-gm-two-player-campaign-sessions
allowedActiveChanges.reason: User-approved declarative-first change for one non-playing GM plus two tactical players: durable command journaling and publication, role-safe live/replay/export projection, reconnect cursors, outcome receipts, append-only correction and rewind, campaign retroactive rebuild, and a strict 80-scenario three-context acceptance program. Implementation is intentionally split into small independently verified PRs with exact-main post-merge regression audits. Its e2e-testing delta adds distinct GM/two-player requirements and does not modify the active add-subsystem-lanes-and-ci requirement names.

allowedActiveChanges.name: restore-encounter-force-selection
allowedActiveChanges.reason: Focused declarative-first repair for the gameplay audit's remaining source-reproducible Critical: both encounter force-selection links currently target an unimplemented route. The change is spec-complete before implementation and is intentionally serialized behind the active combat turn-rail and durability PR boundaries.
